title: graphify cluster() crashes on merged graph during loop graph-update
symptom: During the ingest graph-update step, graphify cluster()/to_json raises TypeError: unhashable type: list on the build_merge-merged graph; graph.json is not rewritten and the cycle stalls.
root_cause: graphify cluster() chokes on a node id / attribute that is a list in the merged extraction produced by build_merge for this corpus (graphify-internal, not an engine bug).
fix: Skip community detection for the run: build_from_json(merged_extract) then to_json(G, {0: list(G.nodes())}, ".graphify/graph.json"). Graph nodes/edges still update incrementally; only clustering is bypassed. Revisit when graphify fixes cluster() on merged input.
